title: Reject ambiguous retrieval policy controls before population admission
observation: The string 'false' is truthy and broadens residual retrieval across populations; invalid forced gates can escape validation when no neighbors are eligible.
cause: Policy controls depended on generic Python truthiness, and forced-gate validation ran only after neighbor selection.
severity: incorrect arithmetic, state or evidence admission on valid/ambiguous boundary inputs
implemented_change: Require an explicit boolean cross-population override and a finite real nonboolean forced gate in [0,1], validating both before eligibility lookup.
predicted_consequence: New constructed regressions fail on the recorded parent and pass after the repair while the existing bounded suite passes.
